subject: Decision Making
subcategory: The Science of Risk and Reward
title: Risk Compensation
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Risk Compensation.

hook.text: Seatbelts save lives. But after seatbelt laws passed, some drivers drove more recklessly. Safety tools changed behavior.

buildup.text: Sam Peltzman found that safer cars led to more aggressive driving. Some safety gains were offset by behavior changes.

discovery.text: Skydivers with better gear attempt more dangerous maneuvers. Football players with helmets tackle harder.

twist.text: Risk compensation does not eliminate the benefit. Seatbelts still save net lives.

climax.text: When we feel safer, we take more chances. Risk is not just physical.

punchline.text: Safer gear, riskier behavior. Protection changes what we are willing to attempt.

quiz.question: What is risk compensation?
options: People take more risks when safety measures make them feel more protected
